thread:
Tom: quick follow-up from the postmortem  we saw the same degraded model-swap path in three separate incidents last quarter. need owners + jira + a clear handoff plan so this doesn't sit in the backlog.
Rina: i'll take investigation ownership (R). creating RWD-9123 for root cause and repro steps. aiming to post a triage note by Wed.
Jules: i'll own the remediation rollout (A) and the canary plan. opening RWD-9124 and linking once Rina's triage lands.
Priya: i'll be consulted on metrics and alerting (C). will prepare a new alert variant for swap-fail rate and add dashboard panels.
Tom: proposed RACI: Rina = R, Jules = A, Priya = C, Tom = I (pm). confirm?
Rina: confirmed. short triage summary: model swap failures correlate with ephemeral storage pressure on node-group-2 during off-peak batch compactions. logs: ```2026-03-20T02:12:11Z model-manager warn: swap_failed id=xyz reason=io_timeout; storage_free_mb=120```
Rina: next steps in RWD-9123: (1) capture repro in perf sandbox (2) add extra logging around compaction windows (3) propose a small config tweak to prefetch swap artifacts.
Jules: mitigation in RWD-9124: add prefetch + increase swap timeout to 45s as a safe interim, run 72h canary on subset. gating: no rollout until canary error rate <= baseline for 72h.
Priya: alerting: creating alert RWD-9125 for swap_fail_rate > 1/min for 5m, page at >3/min. i'll add runbook links.
Tom: owners handoff: Rina to handoff investigation doc + traces to Jules after triage; Jules owns the patch & rollout. Priya owns alerting/playbook.
Rina: tagging ops-bot to create a weekly sync until both tickets closed. @ops-bot please create recurring 30m sync every Thu.
ops-bot: Created recurring event "PM model-swap remediation" starting 2026-03-25 11:00 PT, repeating weekly. Invitation sent to Rina, Jules, Priya, Tom.
Jules: draft PR up, linking RWD-9124; requesting review from Rina and Priya.
Priya: note about recurrence: add a short section in the postmortem about compaction/storage pattern and link it to ops runbooks so future oncall sees history.
Tom: agree. also add a ticket dependency: do not rollout cluster-wide until storage compaction tuning task RWD-9100 is completed.
Jules: added dependency in RWD-9124 comments. merging PR after Rina's thumbs-up and perf tests.
Rina: triage doc posted and handed off. target remediation completion date: 2026-04-07.
Priya: will watch alerts during canary and escalate immediately if swap_fail spikes. :eyes:
Tom: thanks all  leaving thread open for updates and blockers.
